en.bdb: Family customs and the way of Gurmukh

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਦਕ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵਿਰਤੀਸੁਰ ਲਗਾਇਤ ਹੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: naanak dhaadhak saahurai virateesur lagait hoe|

en.bdb: In the house of maternal grandfather, the father-in-law and the  grandfather, priests and servants exist.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣਿ ਭਦਣਿ ਮੰਗਣੈ ਮਰਣੈ ਪਰਣੇ ਕਰਦੇ ਢੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)man bhadhan ma(n)ganai maranai parane karadhe ddoe|

en.bdb: They carry the messages on  births, the mundan (shaving of head) ceremonies, betrothals, marriages and  deaths

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੀਤੀ ਰੂੜੀ ਕੁਲ ਧਰਮ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵਿਖੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: reetee rooRee kul dharam chaj achaar veechaar vikhoe|

en.bdb: They are seen working for the family duties and customs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਕੁਸੂਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ਦੁਲੀਚੇ ਗੈਣ ਚੰਦੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: kar karatoot kusoot vich pai dhuleeche gain cha(n)dhoe|

en.bdb: On occasions such as the sacred thread ceremonies, through many tricks they make the master spend lavishly and tell him about his fame reaching the skies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਧ ਜਠੇਰੇ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਸਤੀਆਂ ਸਉਤ ਟੋਭੜੀ ਟੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: jodh jaThere ma(n)neean sateeaa(n) saut TobhaRee Toe|

en.bdb: Deluded by them people worship departed heroes, ancestors, satis,  deceased co-wives, tanks and pits, but all this is of no avail.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਨਿ ਦਈ ਵਿਗੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh vin mar mar ja(n)man dhiee vigoe|

en.bdb: They who  enjoy not the holy congregation and the word of Guru, die and are born  again and are rejected of God.
It is the follower of the Guru, i.e. Gurmukh  who wears (God's name as his) diamond necklace.
